[1msnetwork test[0m [2m·[0m where am I on the network, at a glance

[1;33mUSAGE[0m
  snetwork                       the summary: every section, a few lines each
  snetwork [36mSECTION[0m [36m[ITEM][0m       one section in full [2m· see[0m snetwork -h sections
  snetwork all                   every section in full

[1;33mOUTPUT[0m
  [32m-json[0m                  the same data as JSON
  [32m-no-color[0m              no colour [2m(also off when output is not a terminal)[0m

[1;33mOTHER[0m
  [32m-v, -version[0m           print the version
  [32m-h, -help[0m [36m[TOPIC][0m      this help [2m· topics:[0m sections[2m,[0m env

[1;33mEXAMPLES[0m
  snetwork vpn                   [2m# tailnet peers, and which subnets they route[0m
  snetwork interfaces en0
  snetwork all > network.txt     [2m# everything, no colour[0m
  snetwork dhcp -json | jq .

[2mPassive: snetwork reads this machine's own state and sends no packets.
Flags go before or after the section, and -json and --json both work.[0m
